title: The Swamp Doesn't Need a Soundtrack
why: Values-driven travelers (Nemesis audience: would rather watch a heron in silence than scream past one): states the silence + Two Swamps belief.
hook_options: The swamp doesn't need a soundtrack.
caption: No motor. No speaker. No wake. Silence is the product, and it's the moment the tour actually starts. Then we show you why it matters: Manchac's cypress, and a ghost swamp in the Lower 9th Ward where restoration is underway. #NOLASwamp #EcoTourism #KayakNOLA #BayouBienvenue

slides.headline: The swamp doesn't need a soundtrack.
slides.body: No motor. No speaker. No wake. Here's why silence is the whole product.

slides.headline: We started because tourism got loud.
slides.body: Airboats, baited gators, guests who left without knowing what they'd seen. We figured a kayak could fix that.

slides.headline: Everyone stop paddling. No sound.
slides.body: Then a shape at 11 o'clock. Guests go quiet without being asked. That's when the tour actually starts.

slides.headline: Paddle drips. Birdsong. Your own breathing.
slides.body: All the stuff a 40 mph boat drowns out before you notice it exists.

slides.headline: But a quiet swamp is a shrinking one.
slides.body: Louisiana's coast keeps losing wetland. Showing you the beauty is step one. Getting you to care is the point.

slides.headline: Manchac shows what's worth saving.
slides.body: The second-largest bald cypress swamp in the US, 30 to 40 minutes from the French Quarter.

slides.headline: Bayou Bienvenue shows what losing looks like.
slides.body: A ghost swamp in the Lower 9th Ward. Open water where cypress stood, and restoration work happening now.

slides.headline: Beautiful and broken. We show you both.
slides.body: Cypress planting and restoration partnerships are part of the job, not a marketing line.

slides.headline: Silence first. Then the story. Then you care.
slides.body: That's the order, every tour, with a guide who actually knows this ecosystem.

slides.kicker: Share this with someone who needs quiet
slides.headline: Come hear what the swamp sounds like.
slides.body: Small-group kayak eco-tours from New Orleans. 12 guests max, trained naturalist guides.
